paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Number of tasks by language family.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with different language families, with the vertical axis listing the language families in a specific order and the horizontal axis representing the number of tasks. The vertical axis is labeled with language family names, listed in the order: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque, with no apparent sorting by the number of tasks. The horizontal axis is labeled "# tasks" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family is represented by a bar of a distinct color, with the length corresponding to the number of tasks: IE-Slavic has the longest bar at approximately 80 tasks, followed by IE-Romance at around 49 tasks, and IE-Germanic at about 45 tasks, while the shortest bars are for Turkic at around 5 tasks and Basque at approximately 3 tasks; the bars are colored light blue, dark blue, green, dark green, pink, red, orange, dark orange, gray, and purple, respectively. The chart provides a visual representation of the distribution of tasks across different language families, with no additional grouping or stacking of bars, and no bars are visually emphasized.
